flash_point.calculation_note: "Typical Inspections" table of the TDS (p.1, version 9th November 2004 (3.1)), footnote "(a) Not a specification". The SDS in the same file (p.6, revision 02Dec2008) prints ">110C (230F)", a lower bound that the typical value meets. A newer SDS revision is not a newer edition of the TDS.
flash_point.notes: Selected under the source-selection policy of 2026-11-10 (TDS value first, SDS fallback); see docs/data_policy_mandatory_review/source_selection_policy.md.

alternate_entries.calculation_note: More recent SDS value (02Dec2008). TDS p.1 (2004) prints 'Flash Point (PM) 190 °C' typical; see conflicts.
alternate_entries.notes: The SDS prints ">110C" (a lower bound); the earlier label value_kind "specification" is not supported by the SDS wording.
alternate_entries.selection_note: Previously selected value, kept as an alternate under the source-selection policy of 2026-11-10. Not judged erroneous: the policy selects the technical-document value first.

open_questions: Flash point: TDS 190 °C (PM) vs SDS '>110C'; recorded as a conflict, field holds the more recent SDS value.

TDS also prints 'Mineral Oil Content 49 mass % Calculated'. SDS p.2 Section 3 component shares: calcium long chain alkyl phenate sulphide 1.0 - 4.9%, tetrapropenylphenol 1.0 - 4.9%, zinc alkyl dithiophosphate 5.0 - 9.9% (not element contents).
B, Mo, S and pour point not printed.

conflicts.note: TDS typical (2004, p.1) vs SDS lower bound (2008, p.6; also p.3 Section 5). Values are compatible (190 > 110) but printed differently; per rule the field holds the more recent SDS value. Not resolved. [2026-11-10 source-selection policy: the field now holds the TDS typical 190 °C (p.1); the SDS ">110C" lower bound is kept as an alternate entry. The two values are compatible (190 > 110) and remain recorded.]
conflicts.final_resolution: Not resolved. The resolution proposed on origin/main (integrate_products.py) was not adopted under the data rules approved on 2026-10-24: no automatic averaging of conflicting values and no automatic preference of TDS over SDS or vice versa. Both values and sources stay as recorded; pending human review. Proposal: TDS preferred over SDS; see fields.flash_point.resolution. TDS preferred over SDS: TDS typical 190 °C (DL2-10204.pdf p.1, 2004) chosen over SDS lower bound '>110 °C' (p.6, 2008), which was in the field under the old newest-document rule.
